senses.definition: At or towards the front; in the direction one is facing or moving.
examples: Just ahead you can see the cliffs.

senses.definition: So as to be further advanced, either spatially or in an abstract sense; to be superior.
examples: He finished two laps ahead of me.
In all of his classes Jack was ahead.
There may be tough times ahead.
You've got to think ahead so as not to be unprepared.
Set the clock ahead an hour.
Push the deadline ahead a day, from the 20th to the 21st.

quotes.text: Then the customer would set a rebidding deadline ahead a month - for example from September 1 to October 1 - and give everybody four weeks to submit […]

quotes.text: When we saw that wasn't working in 1976, we moved the deadline ahead to 1978.

senses.definition: At an earlier time; beforehand; in advance.

examples: Push the deadline ahead a day, from the 21st to the 20th.
